transcript: This woman has the longest nails in the world. 27 years ago, she lost her daughter, who had lovingly done her nails every Sunday. In memory of her, and as a way to cope with the pain of her loss, she stopped cutting her nails. This unusual act became her way of dealing with depression and maintaining a connection with her beloved daughter.
metadata_caption:
The Woman with the World's Longest Nails" tells the story of a mother who, after losing her daughter 27 years ago, stopped cutting her nails to cope with her grief. Her daughter used to do her nails every Sunday, and now, her record-breaking nails symbolize their unbreakable bond.
